extraction.notes: Reconciliation taken from the FFO, Core FFO and AFFO table (page 19), three-month column for June 30, 2022. Starting net loss of $(7,827) differs from the $(7,797) net loss attributable to common stockholders in the financial summary; the reconciliation's own figure was used. All subtotals foot: 17,649 FFO, 20,328 Core FFO, 22,730 AFFO. Per-share checks: 17,649/25,672=0.69, 20,328/25,672=0.79, 22,730/25,672=0.89. AFFO does not deduct recurring capex, so recurring capex of 2,993 for the quarter was taken from the Historical Capital Expenditures table (page 20); its scope is not specified beyond the table. Zero-value lines (loss on extinguishment, pandemic expense) recorded as 0 per printed em dash.
